misused.oewn-02505035-a.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

misused.oewn-02505035-a.tone: The flattest of these - it faults the handling, whether careless or deliberate, without yet accusing anyone of cruelty.

abused.oewn-02505253-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

abused.oewn-02505253-s.tone: Harder than *misused* because excess joins impropriety - the fault lies in how much as well as how, drugs squarely included.

exploited.oewn-02505376-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

exploited.oewn-02505376-s.tone: Cold and calculating beside *ill-used* - it implies someone drew profit from the person, and names the gain rather than the hurt.

ill-used.oewn-02505376-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

ill-used.oewn-02505376-s.tone: Formal and plain-spoken - a verdict that a wrong was done, without *exploited*'s implication that anyone gained by it.

put-upon.oewn-02505376-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

put-upon.oewn-02505376-s.tone: Informal, and the only one of these that shows the wrong from the sufferer's side - the person is imposed on and visibly feels it, where *ill-used* and *exploited* merely report what was done to them.

used.oewn-02505376-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

used.oewn-02505376-s.tone: Bare and cutting - the unmodified participle reduces the person to an instrument, saying far less than *exploited* and landing colder for it.

victimized.oewn-02505376-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

victimized.oewn-02505376-s.tone: The strongest of the set - it does not merely report the wrong but makes the person's whole standing consist in having suffered it.

victimised.oewn-02505376-s.label: negative

family.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

victimised.oewn-02505376-s.tone: British spelling of *victimized*, and it carries the same total verdict - the person defined by the wrong rather than merely subjected to it.

lost.oewn-01453748-a.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

lost.oewn-01453748-a.tone: The softest of these condemnations - it states the doom as a settled condition without naming who or what condemned, where *damned* pronounces the sentence.

cursed.oewn-01454004-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

cursed.oewn-01454004-s.tone: Lays the peril on the subject from outside, as something worked upon them, where *unsaved* reports only a lack.

damned.oewn-01454004-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

damned.oewn-01454004-s.tone: The verdict pronounced outright, naming the punishment rather than circling it - heavier than *doomed*, which only fixes the outcome.

doomed.oewn-01454004-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

doomed.oewn-01454004-s.tone: Settles the peril as fate already fixed, condemning without a condemner, where *cursed* implies something laid it on.

unredeemed.oewn-01454004-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

unredeemed.oewn-01454004-s.tone: Formal and abstract - an account left unsettled rather than a sentence passed, so it lands well short of *damned*.

unsaved.oewn-01454004-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

unsaved.oewn-01454004-s.tone: The flattest way to state the danger, a bare absence of rescue where *damned* is an active condemnation.

destroyed.oewn-01454181-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

destroyed.oewn-01454181-s.tone: Absolute - the wreck, physical or moral, is already complete, where *doomed* leaves it still ahead.

ruined.oewn-01454181-s.label: negative

family.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete

ruined.oewn-01454181-s.tone: Keeps the aftermath in view, something once whole now spoiled, a shade less final than *destroyed*.

ruined.oewn-02342313-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

ruined.oewn-02342313-s.tone: Grave rather than colloquial: the ending is total and stated without relish, where *washed-up* sneers.

inactive.oewn-00036594-a.label: neutral

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

inactive.oewn-00036594-a.tone: The flat, unmarked term for the state, reporting that nothing is going on without suggesting anything is wrong with that.

inactive.oewn-01568708-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

inactive.oewn-01568708-s.tone: On this sense it reports only that a thing is not physically moving, carrying none of the completeness of *motionless*.

dark.oewn-00036876-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

dark.oewn-00036876-s.tone: States a closure as a plain condition — nothing is being put on — where *dead* would make the emptiness itself the verdict.

dead.oewn-00036992-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

dead.oewn-00036992-s.tone: The absolute form: activity is not merely reduced but gone, which is what carries it past *dull*.

dead.oewn-00672155-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

dead.oewn-00672155-s.tone: Blunt and absolute - force and relevance are gone outright, not ebbing as in *obsolescent*.

dull.oewn-00037111-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

dull.oewn-00037111-s.tone: Hears the lack of briskness as a flatness worth complaining about, where *slow* only reports the rate.

slow.oewn-00037111-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

slow.oewn-00037111-s.tone: The mildest of the three, measuring the pace of trade rather than passing judgement on it as *sluggish* does.

sluggish.oewn-00037111-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

sluggish.oewn-00037111-s.tone: Adds torpor to the slackness, making the absence of brisk trade sound like something too heavy to move.

idle.oewn-00037301-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

idle.oewn-00037301-s.tone: Puts a hint of waste on the disuse — something capable of working and sitting there instead — which *unused* does not.

idle.oewn-02005935-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

idle.oewn-02005935-s.tone: A light word for the fault - what is missing is restraint, not any active wrongdoing.

unused.oewn-00037301-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

unused.oewn-00037301-s.tone: Purely factual: it records that the thing is not in use and stops, with none of the reproach in *idle*.

strikebound.oewn-00037454-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault

strikebound.oewn-00037454-s.tone: Names the cause along with the standstill, so it attributes rather than evaluates the stoppage.

nonmoving.oewn-01568466-a.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

nonmoving.oewn-01568466-a.tone: The bare denial - it states only that motion is absent, with none of the held-in-place force of *fixed*.

unmoving.oewn-01568466-a.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

unmoving.oewn-01568466-a.tone: More observational than *nonmoving*, describing a thing seen not to move rather than classifying it as one that does not.

motionless.oewn-01568708-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

motionless.oewn-01568708-s.tone: Complete and picture-like - a body wholly without movement, where *inactive* merely records that none is occurring.

static.oewn-01568708-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

static.oewn-01568708-s.tone: Cool and near-technical, framing stillness as a standing condition of the thing rather than a moment of it as *motionless* does.

still.oewn-01568708-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

still.oewn-01568708-s.tone: The plainest and calmest member - stillness as quiet, not as the arrest that *frozen* implies.

becalmed.oewn-01568905-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

becalmed.oewn-01568905-s.tone: Carries its cause with it - the wind has failed, so the stillness is suffered rather than held, which plain *motionless* leaves open.

fixed.oewn-01568996-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

fixed.oewn-01568996-s.tone: Stillness with something holding it there - not merely unmoving but pinned, which *still* never implies.

set.oewn-01568996-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

set.oewn-01568996-s.tone: Blunter and more settled than *fixed*, suggesting a position taken and no longer open to adjustment.

rigid.oewn-01568996-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

rigid.oewn-01568996-s.tone: Adds stiffness to the fixity - it does not move because it will not bend, where *fixed* says only that it is held.

frozen.oewn-01569274-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

frozen.oewn-01569274-s.tone: The stillness of a sudden stop - motion arrested mid-course rather than never begun, unlike *stationary*.

rooted.oewn-01569274-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

rooted.oewn-01569274-s.tone: Stillness as being held fast from below - immovable rather than simply halted like *frozen*.

stock-still.oewn-01569274-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

stock-still.oewn-01569274-s.tone: The most emphatic way to say it - total, unqualified stillness, without the sense of arrest in *frozen*.

inert.oewn-01569431-s.label: negative

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

inert.oewn-01569431-s.tone: Names an incapacity rather than a state - the thing cannot move or push back, which *motionless* never claims.

sitting.oewn-01569532-s.label: negative

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

sitting.oewn-01569532-s.tone: Stillness read as exposure - it puts a target on whatever it describes, which no other member of the family does.

stationary.oewn-01569645-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile

stationary.oewn-01569645-s.tone: Neutral and positional - stillness as where a thing stands, not something done to it as in *becalmed*.

superior.oewn-02346685-a.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

superior.oewn-02346685-a.tone: The family's plain baseline - it states high rank or importance and leaves the verdict to the reader, where *eminent* already admires.

arch.oewn-02346987-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

arch.oewn-02346987-s.tone: The lightest of the condescension words - superiority worn as a knowing manner rather than pressed on anyone, though it is still looking down.

condescending.oewn-02346987-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

condescending.oewn-02346987-s.tone: Names the fault flatly: a manner that puts the other person below, without the play in *arch*.

patronizing.oewn-02346987-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

patronizing.oewn-02346987-s.tone: The most accusing word for the same attitude - it makes the condescension something done to someone, and expects the reader to object.

patronising.oewn-02346987-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

patronising.oewn-02346987-s.tone: The British spelling of *patronizing*, and it gives up none of the reproach.

eminent.oewn-02347190-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

eminent.oewn-02347190-s.tone: Approving - the height is in quality as much as position, where *high-ranking* only marks the rung.

high.oewn-02347190-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

high.oewn-02347190-s.tone: The barest way to say the same standing - elevation without the honour *eminent* confers.

leading.oewn-02347411-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

leading.oewn-02347411-s.tone: Puts the subject at the front of the field, and does it in a level, unceremonious voice beside *preeminent*.

preeminent.oewn-02347411-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

preeminent.oewn-02347411-s.tone: The strongest praise here - greatness set far enough above the rest that comparison stops mattering.

high-level.oewn-02347647-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

high-level.oewn-02347647-s.tone: Neutral placement: it states elevation in rank or importance and passes no judgement on whoever occupies it.

high-ranking.oewn-02347647-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

high-ranking.oewn-02347647-s.tone: Blunter than *eminent* - elevation as a plain fact of rank, with none of the lustre.

upper-level.oewn-02347647-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

upper-level.oewn-02347647-s.tone: The most colourless of the three - elevation reduced to a tier, with no suggestion of merit.

majestic.oewn-02347861-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

majestic.oewn-02347861-s.tone: Awed rather than merely approving - the superiority sits in the bearing, and it lifts the subject clear of ordinary concerns.

olympian.oewn-02347861-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

olympian.oewn-02347861-s.tone: Cooler and more remote than *majestic* - the loftiness reads as untouched by mundane things rather than warmly grand.

superordinate.oewn-02348073-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

superordinate.oewn-02348073-s.tone: Technical and relational - it fixes one thing above another in an order and carries neither warmth nor reproach.

upper.oewn-02348166-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner

upper.oewn-02348166-s.tone: The shortest term here for standing above, registering the position without any of the admiration in *eminent*.

damaged.oewn-00682414-a.label: neutral

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

damaged.oewn-00682414-a.tone: The family's flat baseline: harm has occurred, and the word passes no verdict on the state it left, where *dilapidated* passes little else.

battered.oewn-00682829-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

battered.oewn-00682829-s.tone: Puts the cause inside the word - blows and hard usage - where *damaged* leaves the cause blank.

beat-up.oewn-00682829-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

beat-up.oewn-00682829-s.tone: Informal where *battered* is neutral in register, treating the same hard usage as something to shrug at rather than record.

beaten-up.oewn-00682829-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

beaten-up.oewn-00682829-s.tone: The fuller form of *beat-up*, equally informal, with a little more of the beating still audible in it.

bedraggled.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

bedraggled.oewn-00682984-s.tone: Wears the deplorable condition on the surface, making it look pitiable rather than shameful, where *derelict* makes it a reproach.

broken-down.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

broken-down.oewn-00682984-s.tone: Names the deplorable state as something that has given way, plainer and more mechanical than *tatterdemalion*.

derelict.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

derelict.oewn-00682984-s.tone: Condemning rather than descriptive - the deplorable state reads as neglect that was allowed to happen, where *dented* is only a fact about a shape.

dilapidated.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

dilapidated.oewn-00682984-s.tone: The formal word for the deplorable state, presenting it as advanced and cumulative decay rather than the single mishap *dented* records.

ramshackle.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

ramshackle.oewn-00682984-s.tone: Adds precariousness to the deplorable state - the thing is not merely poor but barely holding together, which *damaged* never implies.

tatterdemalion.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

tatterdemalion.oewn-00682984-s.tone: The most ornate word in this set, and the flourish makes the contempt sound almost relished beside plain *broken-down*.

tumble-down.oewn-00682984-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

tumble-down.oewn-00682984-s.tone: Plain-spoken where *tatterdemalion* is ornate, and it leaves the deplorable state one shove from collapse.

bent.oewn-00683272-s.label: neutral

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

bent.oewn-00683272-s.tone: Damage as deformation rather than breakage: the shape has gone but not necessarily the use, which *broken* denies outright.

crumpled.oewn-00683272-s.label: neutral

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

crumpled.oewn-00683272-s.tone: Deformation taken across the whole of a thing rather than along one line, so it reads as more thorough than *bent* while judging just as little.

dented.oewn-00683272-s.label: neutral

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

dented.oewn-00683272-s.tone: The most local of these three - one blow's worth of deformation, where *crumpled* takes the whole surface.

broken.oewn-00683423-s.label: neutral

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

broken.oewn-00683423-s.tone: A verdict on function alone: the thing does not work, and the word says nothing about how it got there, where *battered* says little else.

busted.oewn-00683423-s.label: negative

family.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded

busted.oewn-00683423-s.tone: The informal substitute for *broken*, and the drop in register makes the same failure sound offhand rather than serious.

sophisticated.oewn-02278101-a.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

sophisticated.oewn-02278101-a.tone: Praises worldly knowledge and refinement together, and it settles on the thing made for such a person as easily as on the person - a reach *urbane* lacks.

blase.oewn-02278541-s.label: negative

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

blase.oewn-02278541-s.tone: The sophistication is charged to surfeit, which sours the praise - it marks a person as past being impressed where *worldly* only marks them as experienced.

worldly.oewn-02278541-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

worldly.oewn-02278541-s.tone: Takes the versed-in-the-ways-of-the-world half of the sense straight, crediting the experience without the taint of excess *blase* carries.

intelligent.oewn-02278811-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

intelligent.oewn-02278811-s.tone: The approval is for sound knowledge itself, with none of the social finish *sophisticated* insists on.

well-informed.oewn-02278811-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

well-informed.oewn-02278811-s.tone: Flatter than *intelligent* - the credit goes to what a person knows, not to anything in the knower.

polished.oewn-02278936-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

polished.oewn-02278936-s.tone: Praise for the finish, where the assurance is the visible surface and *refined* names the quality under it.

refined.oewn-02278936-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

refined.oewn-02278936-s.tone: Names the refinement itself rather than its display, so it praises without the suggestion of buffing that *polished* carries.

urbane.oewn-02278936-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

urbane.oewn-02278936-s.tone: The formal member, putting the weight on assured ease of manner rather than the surface shine *polished* names.

worldly-wise.oewn-02279187-s.label: positive

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

worldly-wise.oewn-02279187-s.tone: Praises shrewdness rather than polish - it says a person cannot be fooled, which *urbane* never claims.

pleasant.oewn-01805299-a.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

pleasant.oewn-01805299-a.tone: The plain baseline of the family — pleasure that simply agrees with your taste, without the sweetness of *dulcet* or the height of *idyllic*.

beautiful.oewn-01805768-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

beautiful.oewn-01805768-s.tone: Turned on the weather, it rates a day at the top of enjoyable rather than merely *pleasant*.

dulcet.oewn-01805877-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

dulcet.oewn-01805877-s.tone: Intensity turned soft — pleasantness taken to an extreme, but gently, where *gratifying* is emphatic.

enjoyable.oewn-01806033-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

enjoyable.oewn-01806033-s.tone: Unadorned approval of something that gives pleasure, carrying none of the sense of a want answered that *gratifying* adds.

gratifying.oewn-01806033-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

gratifying.oewn-01806033-s.tone: Leans on the satisfaction half of the sense — pleasure that answers something, where *pleasurable* is pleasure for its own sake.

pleasurable.oewn-01806033-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

pleasurable.oewn-01806033-s.tone: The most direct of these three: it names the pleasure itself, with none of the fulfilment *gratifying* implies.

grateful.oewn-01806331-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

grateful.oewn-01806331-s.tone: Describes the thing that gives comfort rather than the person who feels thanks — a warm, easing approval beside the brighter *pleasurable*.

idyllic.oewn-01806450-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

idyllic.oewn-01806450-s.tone: The strongest here — not merely pleasant but charmed, simple and serene, an ideal rather than a preference met.

pleasing.oewn-01806604-s.label: positive

family.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight

pleasing.oewn-01806604-s.tone: Routes approval through whichever sense is doing the work, and stays milder than the extremity of *dulcet*.

animated.oewn-00119378-a.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

animated.oewn-00119378-a.tone: Mild approval - credits a thing with visible vigor without claiming it brims over the way *lively* does.

alive.oewn-00119378-a.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

alive.oewn-00119378-a.tone: Praise cut back to a bare condition - where *animated* shows the vigor off, this only asserts that it is there.

enlivened.oewn-00119655-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

enlivened.oewn-00119655-s.tone: Flat and causal - the liveliness was put in from outside, so the word credits the doing rather than the thing.

spirited.oewn-00119655-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

spirited.oewn-00119655-s.tone: Frankly admiring where *enlivened* stays descriptive - the same imparted liveliness heard as a virtue rather than an effect.

lively.oewn-00119817-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

lively.oewn-00119817-s.tone: A step past *animated*'s mere possession of spirit to fullness of it, and the warmth rises with the quantity.

vital.oewn-00119817-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

vital.oewn-00119817-s.tone: Elevated in register - the same fullness of life as *lively*, but weightier, sounding like a force within rather than a liveliness on show.

reanimated.oewn-00120089-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

reanimated.oewn-00120089-s.tone: States the restoration plainly - fresh vigor recorded as an outcome, with none of the relief *revived* carries.

revived.oewn-00120089-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it

revived.oewn-00120089-s.tone: Warmer than *reanimated* for the same return of vigor - the fresh life sounds like a recovery worth welcoming.

conscionable.oewn-01372980-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

conscionable.oewn-01372980-s.tone: The bar it sets is internal and low - the thing clears your conscience rather than being right in itself, so it approves far more faintly than *fitting*.

fitting.oewn-01373068-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

fitting.oewn-01373068-s.tone: Approval by exactness rather than permission - not merely allowable but precisely right, and it says so plainly where *meet* pronounces.

meet.oewn-01373068-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

meet.oewn-01373068-s.tone: The same verdict as *fitting* delivered as a formal pronouncement, weighty and a little ceremonious, so the rightness sounds handed down rather than observed.

retributive.oewn-01373232-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

retributive.oewn-01373232-s.tone: Cool and measured - what it approves is the fit between deserts and what is dealt out, not whatever it lands on, and it never softens the fact that the thing is inflicted.

retributory.oewn-01373232-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

retributory.oewn-01373232-s.tone: Carries the same verdict as *retributive* with more machinery in the mouth, sounding like the working of paying back rather than the principle behind it.

vindicatory.oewn-01373232-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

vindicatory.oewn-01373232-s.tone: Points at the rightness rather than the sting - where *retributive* names the paying back, this frames the same act as a claim made good.

rightful.oewn-01373402-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts

rightful.oewn-01373402-s.tone: Approval of the coldest kind - a warrant rather than a compliment, resting on validity where *conscionable* rests on conscience.

skilled.oewn-02233368-a.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

skilled.oewn-02233368-a.tone: Plain, checkable praise — it credits capability without admiring it, and can sit on the work that demands the skill as easily as on the person who has it.

accomplished.oewn-02233868-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

accomplished.oewn-02233868-s.tone: Praise with attainment behind it — skill brought to a high finish, warmer and more admiring than the flat *skilled*.

complete.oewn-02233868-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

complete.oewn-02233868-s.tone: Approves by totality rather than dazzle — it says nothing is missing from the skill, a cooler verdict than *accomplished*.

adept.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

adept.oewn-02234002-s.tone: Praise for deft, unlaboured sureness — it admires the aptitude in the doing where *expert* admires the knowing.

expert.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

expert.oewn-02234002-s.tone: The authoritative member: it grants knowledge that can be leaned on and vouched for, weightier and less warm than *good*.

good.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

good.oewn-02234002-s.tone: The mildest approval here — it concedes competence and stops, where *expert* confers standing.

good.oewn-01990227-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

good.oewn-01990227-s.tone: The plainest carrier in the family - it grants the same desert as *estimable* with none of the elevation, approval stated flat.

practiced.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

practiced.oewn-02234002-s.tone: Credits skill that has been worked in until it is habitual, steadier and less brilliant than *virtuoso*.

proficient.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

proficient.oewn-02234002-s.tone: Measured, almost certifying approval — it reports that the standard is met, with none of the admiration in *masterful*.

skillful.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

skillful.oewn-02234002-s.tone: Approves the handling itself — visible dexterity in execution, more concrete than the standing implied by *expert*.

skilful.oewn-02234002-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

skilful.oewn-02234002-s.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the approving weight of *skillful* for deftness in execution.

consummate.oewn-02234724-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

consummate.oewn-02234724-s.tone: Superlative praise — skill carried to its finish with nothing left to add, far above the workaday *proficient*.

masterful.oewn-02234724-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

masterful.oewn-02234724-s.tone: Praise that hears authority in the skill — command of the craft, where *accomplished* only reports a high finish.

masterly.oewn-02234724-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

masterly.oewn-02234724-s.tone: Admires mastery in the execution rather than in the person, the quieter of the pair beside *masterful*.

virtuoso.oewn-02234724-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

virtuoso.oewn-02234724-s.tone: Praise pitched at display — mastery brilliant enough to be watched, showier than the sober *consummate*.

delicate.oewn-02235089-s.label: positive

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

delicate.oewn-02235089-s.tone: Praise for fineness of touch — skill admired for precision and restraint rather than the power heard in *masterful*.

wholesome.oewn-02568127-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

wholesome.oewn-02568127-a.tone: Approval that reaches past the body to character - it can be aimed at a person's morals as readily as at a meal.

alimentary.oewn-02568489-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

alimentary.oewn-02568489-s.tone: Flat and clinical - it states that a thing feeds and stops there, with none of the approval in *nourishing*.

alimental.oewn-02568489-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

alimental.oewn-02568489-s.tone: The stiffer-sounding twin of *alimentary*, carrying the same neutral claim that something supplies nourishment.

nourishing.oewn-02568489-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

nourishing.oewn-02568489-s.tone: Warm where *alimentary* is clinical - the food is credited with doing the body good, not merely with feeding it.

nutrient.oewn-02568489-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

nutrient.oewn-02568489-s.tone: A bare classifier of what a substance supplies, passing no verdict on whether that is welcome.

nutritious.oewn-02568489-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

nutritious.oewn-02568489-s.tone: A quiet recommendation - it praises food for the good it delivers, where *nutrient* only labels it.

nutritive.oewn-02568489-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

nutritive.oewn-02568489-s.tone: Names the capacity to nourish rather than praising the food that has it - the technical member of the set.

heart-healthy.oewn-02568802-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

heart-healthy.oewn-02568802-s.tone: Approval pinned to one measurable thing, and to what the food leaves out rather than what it supplies.

healthy.oewn-02568954-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

healthy.oewn-02568954-s.tone: Plain approval of a thing for the good it does, without the moral reach of *wholesome*.

salubrious.oewn-02568954-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

salubrious.oewn-02568954-s.tone: Formal and slightly grand - the same claim as *healthy* pitched at a height the plainer word never reaches.

good_for_you.oewn-02568954-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

good_for_you.oewn-02568954-s.tone: Informal and addressed to whoever benefits, which makes the good it names personal in a way *salubrious* never is.

hearty.oewn-02569298-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

hearty.oewn-02569298-s.tone: Warm approval of abundance - the meal is praised for filling as well as feeding.

satisfying.oewn-02569298-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

satisfying.oewn-02569298-s.tone: Measures the abundance by its effect on the appetite rather than by the size of the plate.

solid.oewn-02569298-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

solid.oewn-02569298-s.tone: Sturdy and unshowy - the plenty is credited as substance rather than as generosity.

square.oewn-02569298-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

square.oewn-02569298-s.tone: Approval by fair measure - a full and proper portion rather than a lavish one.

substantial.oewn-02569298-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

substantial.oewn-02569298-s.tone: Weighs the meal by sheer bulk, a cooler judgement than *hearty* makes of the same plateful.

constructive.oewn-00587481-a.label: positive

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

constructive.oewn-00587481-a.tone: Approving on two counts at once - it builds and it improves, where *formative* only shapes and leaves the worth of the result open.

creative.oewn-00587863-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

creative.oewn-00587863-s.tone: Approving at one remove: it credits what fosters making rather than the making itself, a lighter claim than the improvement built into *constructive*.

formative.oewn-00588059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

formative.oewn-00588059-s.tone: Neutral - it names the power to shape without saying the shaping is for the better, which is exactly what *constructive* asserts.

shaping.oewn-00588059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

shaping.oewn-00588059-s.tone: Bare and unweighted, the act of forming stated as such, where *formative* points instead at the capacity to form.

plastic.oewn-00588059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

plastic.oewn-00588059-s.tone: Treats the power to mold as a flat property of a thing rather than a merit, which keeps it cooler than *creative*.

inferential.oewn-00588444-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

inferential.oewn-00588444-s.tone: Carries no approval at all - it marks how something is arrived at, by interpretation rather than statement, where *constructive* judges the worth of what is done.

reconstructive.oewn-00588549-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

reconstructive.oewn-00588549-s.tone: Approving of repair: the good it names is a return to sound condition rather than the new making in *constructive*.

rehabilitative.oewn-00588549-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

rehabilitative.oewn-00588549-s.tone: The same restoring good as *reconstructive*, but the longer, more formal word makes the helping sound like a sustained process rather than a single fix.

structural.oewn-00588753-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

structural.oewn-00588753-s.tone: Purely descriptive - it places a thing within a system of study and does none of the approving that runs through *constructive*.

unfinished.oewn-01009264-a.label: negative

family.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

unfinished.oewn-01009264-a.tone: Carries a faint reproach because the thing is measured against the final state that was wanted, so it records a shortfall rather than merely a stage.

roughhewn.oewn-01009605-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

roughhewn.oewn-01009605-s.tone: Neutral about workmanship - the shaping has been done and only the finishing has not, where *unhewn* denies the shaping altogether.

rough-cut.oewn-01009605-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

rough-cut.oewn-01009605-s.tone: Flatter and more matter-of-fact than *roughhewn*, naming the cut alone without that word's suggestion of ruggedly worked bulk.

undressed.oewn-01009725-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

undressed.oewn-01009725-s.tone: Names one specific operation left undone rather than a general falling-short, which keeps it cooler and more technical than *unfinished*.

unfattened.oewn-01009873-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

unfattened.oewn-01009873-s.tone: Coolly commercial disparagement - the animal is graded short of what the market wants, a deficiency stated as plain fact rather than complaint.

unhewn.oewn-01009975-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

unhewn.oewn-01009975-s.tone: Denies the shaping outright where *roughhewn* concedes a first pass, and its as-if reach lets it settle on things no tool was ever near.

strange.oewn-00970318-a.label: neutral

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

strange.oewn-00970318-a.tone: Carries a faint edge of unease that *unusual* does not - what is strange is not merely rare but slightly off.

unusual.oewn-00970318-a.label: neutral

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

unusual.oewn-00970318-a.tone: The flat member of the pair - it records a departure from the expected without *strange*'s hint that something is amiss.

antic.oewn-00970835-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

antic.oewn-00970835-s.tone: Odd to the point of being laughed at - the strangeness reads as clownish rather than menacing.

fantastic.oewn-00970835-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

fantastic.oewn-00970835-s.tone: Oddness inflated past what belief will carry, so the extravagance itself is the fault.

fantastical.oewn-00970835-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

fantastical.oewn-00970835-s.tone: The more elaborate twin of *fantastic* - the oddness sounds invented rather than merely met with.

grotesque.oewn-00970835-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

grotesque.oewn-00970835-s.tone: The harshest of these - the oddness is distorted enough to repel, where *antic* only invites laughter.

crazy.oewn-00971086-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

crazy.oewn-00971086-s.tone: Blunt and informal - it throws up its hands at the strangeness instead of examining it.

curious.oewn-00971199-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

curious.oewn-00971199-s.tone: The oddness is inviting - it asks to be looked into, where *queer* asks to be backed away from.

funny.oewn-00971199-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

funny.oewn-00971199-s.tone: Marks something as not quite right without saying what is wrong with it, and the vagueness is the unease.

odd.oewn-00971199-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

odd.oewn-00971199-s.tone: Registers the deviation flatly, with none of *peculiar*'s second look.

peculiar.oewn-00971199-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

peculiar.oewn-00971199-s.tone: Fastens the oddness onto the thing itself, as a quality it owns rather than an impression it gives.

queer.oewn-00971199-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

queer.oewn-00971199-s.tone: Adds a wariness *odd* lacks - the deviation feels wrong rather than merely noticeable.

rum.oewn-00971199-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

rum.oewn-00971199-s.tone: Informal and offhand - the oddness gets a shrug rather than a verdict.

rummy.oewn-00971199-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

rummy.oewn-00971199-s.tone: A lighter, more throwaway ring than *rum*, the same shrug loosened further.

singular.oewn-00971199-s.label: positive

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

singular.oewn-00971199-s.tone: Deviation read as standing apart rather than as going wrong, so the oddity comes out as distinction where *curious* only makes it inviting.

eerie.oewn-00971711-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

eerie.oewn-00971711-s.tone: The strangeness has turned frightening - it works on the nerves rather than on the judgement.

reputable.oewn-01989711-a.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

reputable.oewn-01989711-a.tone: Approval at its lowest setting - it certifies that a reputation is sound without claiming it is distinguished, which is exactly what *esteemed* claims.

esteemed.oewn-01990022-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

esteemed.oewn-01990022-s.tone: Warm and elevating - the regard is felt rather than merely recorded, and pitched high enough to make the reputation an illustrious one.

honored.oewn-01990022-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

honored.oewn-01990022-s.tone: Frames the standing as a distinction conferred and marked, where *esteemed* leaves it as regard quietly held.

prestigious.oewn-01990022-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

prestigious.oewn-01990022-s.tone: Puts the weight on the shine of the name itself - impressiveness rather than the warmth *esteemed* carries toward the person holding it.

honoured.oewn-01990022-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

honoured.oewn-01990022-s.tone: The British spelling of *honored*, identical in force and in the conferred distinction it implies.

estimable.oewn-01990227-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

estimable.oewn-01990227-s.tone: Formal, and it turns on desert rather than receipt - the respect is owed whether or not anyone is paying it, unlike *respected*.

honorable.oewn-01990227-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

honorable.oewn-01990227-s.tone: Weights the desert toward conduct - respect a person has earned, where *prestigious* names respect that standing confers.

honorable.oewn-01229113-a.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

honorable.oewn-01229113-a.tone: The plain claim of the family - it certifies that respect is deserved, without the awe *august* and *venerable* pile on top.

respectable.oewn-01990227-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

respectable.oewn-01990227-s.tone: Praise measured to the bar rather than to the height - it says the standard is met and stops well short of admiration.

admirable.oewn-01990227-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

admirable.oewn-01990227-s.tone: The warmest word here - it does not merely permit respect but calls for it, wholehearted where *respectable* is guarded.

redoubtable.oewn-01990497-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

redoubtable.oewn-01990497-s.tone: Formal and weighty, and the respect it claims keeps its distance - something closer to awe than to the warmth of *admirable*.

respected.oewn-01990613-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

respected.oewn-01990613-s.tone: Reports regard actually given rather than deserved - the mirror of *estimable*, which claims the desert and says nothing about receipt.

well-thought-of.oewn-01990613-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

well-thought-of.oewn-01990613-s.tone: The plain-spoken, understated form of *respected*: the same deference, named without ceremony.

time-honored.oewn-01990737-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

time-honored.oewn-01990737-s.tone: Approves by duration rather than by merit - the warrant is how long a thing has been accepted, not whether it deserves to be.

time-honored.oewn-01229870-s.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

time-honored.oewn-01229870-s.tone: Approval with its grounds stated - the honor is credited to having lasted, where *honorable* and *venerable* name the honor without saying what earned it.

time-honoured.oewn-01990737-s.label: positive

family.axis: a sound reputation → illustrious standing that commands deference

time-honoured.oewn-01990737-s.tone: The British spelling of *time-honored*, carrying the same dignity conferred by long standing.

time-honoured.oewn-01229870-s.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

time-honoured.oewn-01229870-s.tone: The British spelling, endorsing a thing for its endurance in precisely the terms *time-honored* uses.

profitable.oewn-01876839-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

profitable.oewn-01876839-a.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it reports that a return exists and says nothing about its size or how welcome it is, which is the whole of what *juicy* adds.

bankable.oewn-01877172-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

bankable.oewn-01877172-s.tone: Approves through certainty rather than size - the profit is treated as already secured, where *profitable* claims only that it is there.

fat.oewn-01877317-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

fat.oewn-01877317-s.tone: Relish rather than accounting - it praises a return by its sheer thickness, where *profitable* merely records one.

juicy.oewn-01877317-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

juicy.oewn-01877317-s.tone: Appetite - it makes the profit tempting, something to be got at, where *fat* only makes it thick.

gainful.oewn-01877441-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

gainful.oewn-01877441-s.tone: Measured approval - the return it names is a fair one rather than a large one, which keeps it clear of the greed in *juicy*.

paid.oewn-01877441-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

paid.oewn-01877441-s.tone: Understated for a return that is fair rather than large - the profit is granted without being praised.

paying.oewn-01877441-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

paying.oewn-01877441-s.tone: Mildly approving - it treats the return as something the thing keeps doing, where *paid* records only that it happened.

economic.oewn-01877533-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

economic.oewn-01877533-s.tone: The dry member - it approves by the ledger, granting a reward without any of the appetite in *fat* or *juicy*.

lucrative.oewn-01877742-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

lucrative.oewn-01877742-s.tone: Formal and emphatic at once - the size of the profit is the entire claim, stated without the hunger of *juicy*.

moneymaking.oewn-01877742-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

moneymaking.oewn-01877742-s.tone: Blunt where *lucrative* is formal - it names the money outright and lets that stand as the praise.

remunerative.oewn-01877742-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

remunerative.oewn-01877742-s.tone: The most formal way to say it - it lends a sizeable profit a decorum that *moneymaking* makes no attempt at.

unsuccessful.oewn-02341445-a.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

unsuccessful.oewn-02341445-a.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records the unfavorable outcome and passes no verdict on whoever met it.

attempted.oewn-02341872-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

attempted.oewn-02341872-s.tone: Marks the act as the thing that failed rather than the one who made it, which is where it parts from *defeated*.

defeated.oewn-02341968-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

defeated.oewn-02341968-s.tone: Failure recast as a loss to something stronger, carrying the sting of being beaten that *unsuccessful* leaves out.

disappointed.oewn-02341968-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

disappointed.oewn-02341968-s.tone: The softest of the blocked set - the failure sits in a hope let down rather than in any force that stopped it, unlike *thwarted*.

discomfited.oewn-02341968-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

discomfited.oewn-02341968-s.tone: Formal, and it puts the disappointment into the failure itself rather than into the effort that led there.

foiled.oewn-02341968-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

foiled.oewn-02341968-s.tone: Sounds the note of a scheme blocked at the last moment, lighter and more gleeful than the grim *thwarted*.

frustrated.oewn-02341968-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

frustrated.oewn-02341968-s.tone: Puts the weight on effort spent for nothing, so the failure feels drawn out rather than delivered in one blow like *defeated*.

thwarted.oewn-02341968-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

thwarted.oewn-02341968-s.tone: The hardest of the blocked set - something outside did the stopping, and the word gives that force a weight *foiled* does not.

done_for.oewn-02342313-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

done_for.oewn-02342313-s.tone: Informal and final, a verdict pronounced with none of the room for recovery that *frustrated* still leaves open.

sunk.oewn-02342313-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

sunk.oewn-02342313-s.tone: Blunt and informal, a one-syllable verdict that closes the matter faster than *ruined* does.

undone.oewn-02342313-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

undone.oewn-02342313-s.tone: Formal and near-elegiac, treating the end as something that came apart rather than something that was smashed.

washed-up.oewn-02342313-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

washed-up.oewn-02342313-s.tone: The most contemptuous of the doomed set - it dismisses as much as it describes, which *undone* never does.

down-and-out.oewn-02342428-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

down-and-out.oewn-02342428-s.tone: Widens the failure to a whole condition, nothing held and nothing coming, with a bleakness *empty-handed* keeps at arm's length.

empty-handed.oewn-02342553-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

empty-handed.oewn-02342553-s.tone: Concrete where *unrewarded* is abstract - it shows the nothing instead of naming it.

unrewarded.oewn-02342553-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

unrewarded.oewn-02342553-s.tone: Neutral and faintly on the subject's side, recording that nothing came of it without calling the effort wasted.

honourable.oewn-01229113-a.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

honourable.oewn-01229113-a.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the same entitlement to respect as *honorable* with nothing added or softened.

august.oewn-01229533-s.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

august.oewn-01229533-s.tone: Lofty and formal - it raises the honor so high it puts distance between subject and speaker, where *honorable* stays level with you.

revered.oewn-01229533-s.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

revered.oewn-01229533-s.tone: Locates the honor in those who feel it - the regard is actively given, not merely owed as with *honorable*.

venerable.oewn-01229533-s.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

venerable.oewn-01229533-s.tone: Solemn - it wraps the honor in a hush of reverence rather than the ceremonial elevation of *august*.

laureate.oewn-01229682-s.label: positive

family.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

laureate.oewn-01229682-s.tone: Superlative - it does not merely grant honor but sets its object at the summit of it, where *honorable* only confirms the desert.

irresponsible.oewn-02005010-a.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

irresponsible.oewn-02005010-a.tone: The plain charge the rest take their colour from - blame falls on the consequences left unweighed, with none of the cheer of *carefree*.

carefree.oewn-02005360-s.label: positive

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

carefree.oewn-02005360-s.tone: The most forgiving word here - the missing care reads as freedom from burden rather than neglect of duty.

devil-may-care.oewn-02005360-s.label: positive

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

devil-may-care.oewn-02005360-s.tone: Bravado rather than lightness - it flaunts the disregard where *carefree* simply has no worry to shed.

freewheeling.oewn-02005360-s.label: positive

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

freewheeling.oewn-02005360-s.tone: Motion with the brakes off - it approves the ease while leaving the absent check audible.

happy-go-lucky.oewn-02005360-s.label: positive

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

happy-go-lucky.oewn-02005360-s.tone: Indulgent - it credits a temperament rather than charging a fault.

harum-scarum.oewn-02005360-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

harum-scarum.oewn-02005360-s.tone: Its jingling repetition makes the cheer sound scatterbrained, tipping into scolding where *happy-go-lucky* stays fond.

slaphappy.oewn-02005360-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

slaphappy.oewn-02005360-s.tone: The cheer here undercuts the person as giddy and unfit to be trusted, where *carefree* leaves them intact.

do-nothing.oewn-02005635-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

do-nothing.oewn-02005635-s.tone: Flatly dismissive - it writes someone off by what they never get done, with no charm allowed into the failing.

feckless.oewn-02005830-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

feckless.oewn-02005830-s.tone: A verdict of unfitness rather than a report of behaviour, and the most withering word in the set.

loose.oewn-02005935-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

loose.oewn-02005935-s.tone: Carries a moral edge *idle* does not - the restraint gone slack is the kind a person is expected to hold.

trigger-happy.oewn-02006089-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

trigger-happy.oewn-02006089-s.tone: The cheerful *-happy* ending set against carelessness with a gun is the whole sting of it.

unaccountable.oewn-02006185-s.label: neutral

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

unaccountable.oewn-02006185-s.tone: Positional rather than evaluative - it states the absence of anyone to answer to, without judging the person for it.

unreliable.oewn-02006280-s.label: negative

family.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

unreliable.oewn-02006280-s.tone: Judged from outside - where *irresponsible* looks at the consequences, this looks at whoever was depending.

pure.oewn-01911832-a.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

pure.oewn-01911832-a.tone: The unrestricted term of the family — nothing extraneous of any kind survives it, where *clean* answers only to impurity.

axenic.oewn-01912370-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

axenic.oewn-01912370-s.tone: Technical and exact: it certifies that a culture of microorganisms holds no other organism, a specification rather than a compliment.

clean.oewn-01912517-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

clean.oewn-01912517-s.tone: Approving in a plain, physical way — the impurities are gone, and it says so without the ceremony of *pristine*.

fresh.oewn-01912517-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

fresh.oewn-01912517-s.tone: Names the same absence of impurity as *clean* but with a livelier, more inviting force.

clear.oewn-01912661-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

clear.oewn-01912661-s.tone: Praise for a sound or colour that nothing dulls or dims — the brightness is the point, not the absence of dirt that *clean* answers to.

light.oewn-01912661-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

light.oewn-01912661-s.tone: Softer and less emphatic than *clear* for the same undulled sound or colour, approving without insisting.

unclouded.oewn-01912661-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

unclouded.oewn-01912661-s.tone: The negative form makes the dimness explicit, praising a sound or colour by naming what fails to cloud it where *clear* simply asserts the brightness.

fine.oewn-01913014-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

fine.oewn-01913014-s.tone: Gradable where the rest are absolute: purity here is a degree that can be high or specified, so it measures where *pure* merely declares.

native.oewn-01913172-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

native.oewn-01913172-s.tone: Descriptive rather than evaluative — it records that the thing already stands in its elemental form in nature, and attaches no credit to that.

plain.oewn-01913300-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

plain.oewn-01913300-s.tone: The flattest word here, stating that nothing extraneous is mixed in and neither admiring nor disparaging the fact.

sheer.oewn-01913300-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

sheer.oewn-01913300-s.tone: Absolute in force where *plain* is merely factual, pressing on the totality of the unmixedness rather than reporting it.

unmingled.oewn-01913300-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

unmingled.oewn-01913300-s.tone: Formal and slightly stiff, denying admixture in so many words rather than asserting purity outright as *pure* does.

unmixed.oewn-01913300-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

unmixed.oewn-01913300-s.tone: The blunt, unceremonious form of that same denial — *unmingled* says it formally, this says it flatly.

pristine.oewn-01913490-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

pristine.oewn-01913490-s.tone: The admiring extreme — not merely unmixed but wholly untouched by dirt or contamination, a completeness *clean* never claims.

straight_up.oewn-01913613-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

straight_up.oewn-01913613-s.tone: A serving instruction rather than a judgement: the drink met the ice and was left without it, and the phrase passes no verdict on the result.

sublimate.oewn-01913797-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

sublimate.oewn-01913797-s.tone: The opposite arrival from *native* — purity reached by being made, stated as a result rather than praised.

impressive.oewn-01285124-a.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

impressive.oewn-01285124-a.tone: The family's plain measure of approval - something lands strongly, with none of the claim to flatten you that *staggering* makes.

amazing.oewn-01285602-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

amazing.oewn-01285602-s.tone: Unguarded warmth, all wonder and no weight, where *awe-inspiring* holds the same admiration at arm's length.

awe-inspiring.oewn-01285602-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

awe-inspiring.oewn-01285602-s.tone: Formal, and it names the effect instead of voicing it - it reports what a thing does to an onlooker where *amazing* simply exclaims.

awesome.oewn-01285602-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

awesome.oewn-01285602-s.tone: Names the reaction rather than the quality that provoked it - the response is the whole of the claim.

awful.oewn-01285602-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

awful.oewn-01285602-s.tone: Sits at the awe end of this sense - the impression overpowers rather than pleases, which is the whole distance between it and *amazing*.

awing.oewn-01285602-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

awing.oewn-01285602-s.tone: A flat participle that states the effect and stops, carrying none of the speaker's own delight that *awesome* puts on show.

arresting.oewn-01286013-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

arresting.oewn-01286013-s.tone: Attention is seized and held - it stops you mid-stride, where *impressive* only invites you to admire at your leisure.

sensational.oewn-01286013-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

sensational.oewn-01286013-s.tone: The attention is commanded by display, and the word grants that the display worked.

stunning.oewn-01286013-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

stunning.oewn-01286013-s.tone: Commands attention by knocking it loose - the looking is involuntary, not the considered halt of *arresting*.

astonishing.oewn-01286247-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

astonishing.oewn-01286247-s.tone: Surprise is the mechanism here: it overwhelms because it exceeds what you were braced for, not because it is merely large.

astounding.oewn-01286247-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

astounding.oewn-01286247-s.tone: A heavier landing than *astonishing* - the surprise does not just register, it takes the ground out from under.

staggering.oewn-01286247-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

staggering.oewn-01286247-s.tone: The overwhelm is bodily - it arrives as weight and puts you off balance, where *astonishing* works on the expectations instead.

stupefying.oewn-01286247-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

stupefying.oewn-01286247-s.tone: The stun taken to its blank end, where the mind goes slack rather than sharp, so the admiration comes dulled.

baronial.oewn-01286600-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

baronial.oewn-01286600-s.tone: Grandeur with rank in it - the scale reads as lordly, claiming consequence rather than just filling space.

imposing.oewn-01286600-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

imposing.oewn-01286600-s.tone: Impressiveness that presses down on the onlooker, commanding respect from a slight distance and closer to daunting than to inviting.

noble.oewn-01286600-s.label: positive

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

noble.oewn-01286600-s.tone: The bulk or bearing reads as dignity, an elevation of quality, where *imposing* achieves its effect by weight alone.

moving.oewn-01564906-a.label: positive

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

moving.oewn-01564906-a.tone: The plainest full-strength term here — it credits depth of feeling without saying what the feeling is, where *heartwarming* and *haunting* each name its colour.

affecting.oewn-01565214-s.label: neutral

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

affecting.oewn-01565214-s.tone: The barest of the three that share this sense — it reports that feeling was produced and stops there, where *poignant* and *touching* each put a force behind it.

poignant.oewn-01565214-s.label: positive

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

poignant.oewn-01565214-s.tone: The keenest of the three — the feeling it names arrives with an edge, where *touching* arrives softly.

touching.oewn-01565214-s.label: positive

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

touching.oewn-01565214-s.tone: The mildest of the three — a small stir of feeling rather than the keen pull *poignant* exerts.

haunting.oewn-01565472-s.label: neutral

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

haunting.oewn-01565472-s.tone: The one member whose effect is unwelcome — it credits real depth while naming the disturbance, where *heartwarming* credits only the pleasure.

heartwarming.oewn-01565673-s.label: positive

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

heartwarming.oewn-01565673-s.tone: Unmixed warmth — the only member that guarantees the feeling is a glad one, where *moving* leaves the kind of emotion open.

stirring.oewn-01565822-s.label: positive

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

stirring.oewn-01565822-s.tone: Rousing rather than tender — it makes the emotion strong and forward-moving while ruling out the discomfort *haunting* trades in.

soul-stirring.oewn-01565822-s.label: positive

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

soul-stirring.oewn-01565822-s.tone: The emphatic form of the same sense — it puts the whole self behind the feeling *stirring* merely raises.

smart.oewn-00440447-a.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

smart.oewn-00440447-a.tone: The family's plain approving term - alertness and resourcefulness credited straight, with none of the self-interested edge *cagey* carries.

astute.oewn-00440649-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

astute.oewn-00440649-s.tone: Praise for judgement that sees through a situation, formal in register and weightier than *sharp*, which credits speed instead.

sharp.oewn-00440649-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

sharp.oewn-00440649-s.tone: The same practical intelligence as *astute*, but felt as quickness and edge rather than depth.

shrewd.oewn-00440649-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

shrewd.oewn-00440649-s.tone: Approves the hardheaded part out loud, so the compliment comes with a coolness *astute* does not have.

cagey.oewn-00440992-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

cagey.oewn-00440992-s.tone: Credits the shrewdness while flagging the guardedness - intelligence held close and used defensively, which is why the approval is only half given.

cagy.oewn-00440992-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

cagy.oewn-00440992-s.tone: An alternate spelling carrying exactly the force of *cagey*, wariness and self-interest both.

canny.oewn-00440992-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

canny.oewn-00440992-s.tone: Makes the self-interest sound like sound sense rather than concealment, warming what *cagey* leaves guarded.

clever.oewn-00440992-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

clever.oewn-00440992-s.tone: The double-edged member - it grants the quickness while letting the self-interest show, so it can compliment and needle in one word.

streetwise.oewn-00441171-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

streetwise.oewn-00441171-s.tone: Respect for intelligence proved under pressure rather than taught - resourcefulness measured by whether it keeps a person going in a city.

street_smart.oewn-00441171-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

street_smart.oewn-00441171-s.tone: Says what *streetwise* says with the parts laid bare, the street and the smartness named separately, which makes it land blunter.

with-it.oewn-00441171-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

with-it.oewn-00441171-s.tone: Informal and light, it makes the same survival-sharpness sound like being clued in rather than hardened by it.

noncurrent.oewn-00671807-a.label: neutral

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

noncurrent.oewn-00671807-a.tone: The flattest term here - a bare negation of present-day standing, without the verdict *obsolete* passes.

back.oewn-00672052-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

back.oewn-00672052-s.tone: Purely positional - it sets something at an earlier date and judges nothing about it.

disused.oewn-00672257-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

disused.oewn-00672257-s.tone: States the plain fact of non-use and leaves the reason alone.

obsolete.oewn-00672257-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

obsolete.oewn-00672257-s.tone: The same non-use as *disused*, but delivered as a verdict rather than an observation.

outdated.oewn-00672374-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

outdated.oewn-00672374-s.tone: Faults the thing for its age, withdrawing validity and fashion in one stroke.

out-of-date.oewn-00672374-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

out-of-date.oewn-00672374-s.tone: Plain and unemphatic - it reports the same lapse *outdated* reports, with less of the reproach.

superannuated.oewn-00672374-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

superannuated.oewn-00672374-s.tone: Formal and faintly withering - age is treated as having disqualified the thing.

obsolescent.oewn-00672603-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

obsolescent.oewn-00672603-s.tone: Marks the slide rather than the arrival - on its way to what *obsolete* already is.
